decision: Retain the qualified audit and fixed-workload findings. Defer blanket shared-budget deployment. Next prototype exact-scope in-flight public request sharing with independent subscriber receipt provenance and failure semantics.
falsifier: Changed source or receipt bytes, an independent arithmetic/replay mismatch, lost or early-dispatched requests, collector ordering/capacity violations, or later representative traces without the observed duplicate opportunity update the relevant claim. No profitability or live-failure claim is made.
hypothesis: A fixed authenticated public-request trace can distinguish duplicate traffic and scheduling trade-offs before changing active acquisition or financial execution.
limitations: One hour of five public research collectors; financial and other-IP traffic unmeasured.
Floor/ceiling charges approximate documented accounting; estimated peaks do not prove venue rejection.
Identical in-flight requests are a trace opportunity, not actual deployed savings or permission to merge receipts.
Fixed-workload replay does not model real deadline deferral, replanning, recovery queries or changed future response values.
Fresh-candle deadline is a query proxy, not a per-observation replay.
Ten-second duration is an assumed stress scenario; no scheduler optimality is claimed.
Small backend log segment is incomplete HTTP telemetry.
One defensive model branch remains uncovered; no trading outcomes or profitability were evaluated.
Active collectors, study declarations, financial source/configuration and processes remain unchanged.
